# YouTube source capture — interview red flags before accepting

Captured: 2026-10-29

## Source

- Video: [5 Job Interview Red Flags That Scream Toxic Workplace](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mHqVlYalhm0)
- Channel: Lucy on Life
- Video duration: approximately 18 minutes 15 seconds
- Visible page state: YouTube displayed the video and description, but its player reported closed captions unavailable.

## Caption capture

`yt-dlp` 2026.08.19 successfully retrieved English and English-original automatic caption tracks without downloading the video. The preserved source file is [mHqVlYalhm0.en-orig.vtt](mHqVlYalhm0.en-orig.vtt).

Reproduction command:

```powershell
yt-dlp --skip-download --write-auto-subs --sub-langs "en-orig" --sub-format vtt --no-playlist "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mHqVlYalhm0"
```

## Evidence status

The captions are machine-generated source material. They are useful for extracting the speaker's themes, but wording, punctuation, names and negations may be wrong. The video is one creator's advice, not prevalence evidence. Viewer comments are anecdotal and selected by engagement; they are not representative user research.

The interpreted notes are recorded in [the reviewed result](../../../../04_results/product-and-users/2026-10-29-pre-interview-job-red-flags.md).
